notes.title: First update for VRDrivers!
notes.content:
It's the first update for VRDrivers! We have changed and added the following:

 added hands on the steering wheel
 now you can change difficulty level
 faster navigation in menu
 improved pause menu
 fixed some bugs

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30711291/667b99c2b27d884c303d427ed1208d2359b2bba1.png
